question: How is consciousness gathered and moved in this stage of the practice?
premises: Consciousness enters through one of the channels.
It is concentrated into a mass in the abode of the bulb.
It is then forcibly circulated with a flame of five and eight.
inference: The practice involves forceful concentration and circulation of consciousness through the subtle body.
uncertainties: The symbolic meaning of 'a flame of five and eight' is not explained in this verse.
plain_english: Entering through one of the channels, one concentrates consciousness into a mass in the bulb, then forcibly circulates it with a flame of five and eight.
